Own backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery capabilities for infrastructure services; conduct and document regular restoration and failover tests. Develop, maintain, and test business continuity and disaster-recovery procedures for critical infrastructure platforms. Maintain accurate network diagrams, infrastructure inventories, configuration standards, runbooks, recovery procedures, and technical documentation. Ensure infrastructure practices support applicable company security, privacy, compliance, and audit requirements. Minimum of 2 years of experience in an infrastructure, systems, network, cloud operations, or IT operations management capacity. Demonstrated experience leading technical teams, vendors, managed service providers, or complex infrastructure projects. Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise network services across multiple sites and remote users.
